title: Zigs and Zags
lines: Liz and Zac sit on a rug.
"I have a quiz, Zac," said Liz.
"What has six legs and can dig?" she said.
Zac hums, but he can not get it.
"It is not a cat," said Liz.
A bug runs up on the rug.
It zigs and zags up to his mug and sits.
"A bug! It has six legs," said Zac.
"You got it," said Liz, and Zac hops up.
